title: Cover ACL reader cleanup wiring through the denied-root wrappers
outcome: Cover ACL reader cleanup wiring through the denied-root wrappers
acceptance: A cross-platform deterministic test drives withDeniedRoot with an injected denial that holds a fake ACL reader and verifies shutdown, restore, reader close, then root/home deletion in order.
A reader-close failure through the same wrappers retains both fixtures; removing either closeReader forwarding line makes the regression fail without waiting for a process timeout.
